licenses.text:
George Eliot, Silas Marner.
Standard Ebooks edition: https://standardebooks.org/ebooks/george-eliot/silas-marner

People whose words are in the text, and their death years:
- George Eliot, the author, died 1880 (Wikidata Q131333, P570 = 1880-12-22).

First publication of the text used: 1861, United Kingdom (SE colophon: 'Silas Marner was published in 1861 by George Eliot.'; Wikipedia infobox for Silas Marner: publication place United Kingdom, publication date 2 April 1861, https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Silas_Marner).

Why this is public domain:
- United States: the text was first published in 1861, before 1931;
  a published work enters the United States public domain 95 years after
  publication, so this work entered it in 1956.
- Country of origin (United Kingdom): copyright there lasts for life plus 70 years
  after the death of the last surviving person named above. The last to die
  did so in 1880, so the work entered the public domain there on
  1 January 1951.

They may still be copyrighted in other countries, so users located outside of the United States must check their local laws before using this ebook.
